tdd_audit: All 7 steps are tdd:true, each with a test_cmd and both red+green tdd_evidence in phases/shopspend-hardening/index.json. No tdd:false scaffolding step exists, so no escape-hatch findings. Test coverage gap noted separately as issue 2 (backfill-gap -> span -> verified-empty interaction is untested).

issues.summary: doPost is unauthenticated (appsscript.json access: ANYONE_ANONYMOUS, executeAs USER_DEPLOYING) and this diff adds `weeks_verified_empty` to it — a field whose entire purpose is to BYPASS the blast-radius breaker in shopspend.gs. A single anonymous POST of {kind:'shopspend', rows:[], weeks_complete:['2026-W31'], weeks_verified_empty:['2026-W31']} zeroes every present shop-week in that week, and docs/api.md:160-170 publishes that exact curl. doGet is token-gated via checkReadToken_ (Code.gs:1472-1475); doPost has no equivalent check. Before this phase the worst an anonymous POST could do was append rows (self-correcting) — the breaker-exempt path is new destructive surface on an open endpoint. Gate doPost on a shared ingest token (or at minimum gate weeks_verified_empty on one).

--backfill narrows to MISSING weeks via missing_weeks_for_backfill (line 148), then collapses them to a contiguous span with `from_week, to_week = weeks[0], weeks[-1]` (line 314). compute_weeks_complete re-expands that to iso_week_span(from_week, to_week) and declares EVERY spanned week complete — undoing the narrowing on the destructive side. Failure scenario: covered = {W29, W30}, missing = [W28, W31] (machine off two non-adjacent Mondays) -> span W28..W31. If the API returns no rows for W29/W30 (retention/lookback window, partially-recovered upstream outage) while the aggregate gates still pass (matched>0 from W28/W31 rows, rows==matched, not truncated, totalOrdersScanned>0), then W29 and W30 are declared weeks_verified_empty and every present shop-week in them is tombstoned to zero — breaker-bypassed, because verified-empty is exempt. The connector asserts 'verified empty' about weeks it deliberately was not refreshing. UNTESTED: test_runner.py covers backfill narrowing and the gate separately, but no test exercises backfill-with-a-gap -> span -> verified-empty. Restrict weeks_complete/weeks_verified_empty to the weeks actually requested (`weeks`), not the contiguous span.

_build_pull writes the gate's FULL weeks_complete list into diagnostics_json.harness, but ingest.post_pull then strips split weeks (>chunk_size rows) and undeclared weeks before posting, so those weeks are never actually declared to GAS. docs/schema.md:170 states the harness key exists so 'a regression that silently disables absence detection [is] visible in the Sheet' — in exactly that case the Sheet claims the week WAS declared. The only other signal is a stderr warning, which shopspend.gs:186-191's own comment says goes to a gitignored log nobody reads. Have post_pull return the weeks it actually declared and record those.

compute_weeks_complete reads paging.truncated from response.meta, but client.fetch freezes response_meta to the FIRST page only (client.py:127-131, `if response_meta is None`). Step 3 fixed precisely this first-page problem for `returned` (switching _build_pull to len(response.rows)) but left `truncated` reading first-page state, so a pull the API flags as truncated only on a later page passes the completeness gate and is declared complete. Mitigated but not closed by the `len(response.rows) < paging.matched` gate and the new NO_PROGRESS guard. Track truncated as an OR across all pages.

docs/api.md:117 and :138 both point at docs/schema.md 'shopSpend tabs' for the definition of weeks_complete / weeks_verified_empty, but schema.md documents neither field — the doPost ingest payload contract there was not extended with the two new request fields (only the diagnostics_json row mentions them in passing). Dangling cross-reference on the two fields that gate a destructive write; CLAUDE.md names docs/schema.md as the contract of record.

_week_label's regex \d{4}-W\d{2} accepts out-of-range week numbers such as 2026-W00 and 2026-W99. Those phantom labels survive argparse, flow into iso_week_span, and are declared complete (and, having no rows, verified-empty). Harmless in practice today — no sheet row carries such a label, and a range consisting only of phantom weeks trips the matched==0 gate — but the validator's stated purpose (its own docstring) is to reject malformed labels cleanly before the fetch. Bound the week number to 01-53.
